title: Conformity & Obedience: Exam-Style Stretch
welcome_lead: Evaluate Milgram and weigh situational vs dispositional explanations.

final_note: You can write a balanced AO3 paragraph with named studies.

concepts.def: Moving from autonomy to acting for authority.
Person feels responsible for their actions.
How well lab results apply to real life.
Cues telling participants how to behave.

walkthroughs.body_html: Milgram's agentic state theory says we shift from feeling personally responsible (autonomous) to acting as an agent of authority. This shift can be triggered by uniforms, legitimate setting and 'just doing my job' framing.

Adorno argued some people score high on the F-scale and are more obedient — a dispositional account. Critics say situation matters more than personality; Milgram's variations changed obedience rates dramatically.

Strengths: high internal control, dramatic findings, real-world relevance (e.g. Nazi crimes). Weaknesses: ethical issues (consent, harm), lab settings can lack ecological validity, demand characteristics may inflate effects.
